task_text: I have a video call starting in 5 minutes. My desk area needs to look presentable and I should be able to see and hear clearly. The bedroom light is off.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare any light objects in the living room that need to be passed to R2 for the bedroom.
central_instructions.R2: Move to the bedroom to assist with passing objects between R3 and R4, and ensure the bedroom light is turned on.
central_instructions.R3: Organize and prepare any light objects in the bedroom that need to be passed to R4 for desk arrangement.
central_instructions.R4: Turn on the bedroom light and arrange the desk area to make it presentable for the video call.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Identify any light objects in the living room that need to be passed to R2 for the bedroom. (r1_s1)
- R2 [ASK_HELP] Request R1 to pass any necessary light objects for the bedroom. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [PASS] Pass identified light objects to R2. (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive light objects from R1. (r2_s2)
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the bedroom to place the light objects appropriately. (r2_s3)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the bedroom. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Turn on the bedroom light. (r2_s2)
- R2 [HELP] Assist R3 and R4 with passing objects. (r2_s3)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Pick up the notebook from the desk. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Pick up the pen from the desk. (r3_s2)
- R3 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Pick up the phone from the desk. (r3_s3)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [RECEIVE] Receive notebook from R3. (r4_s1)
- R3 [PASS] Pass notebook to R4. (r3_s4)
- R4 [RECEIVE] Receive pen from R3. (r4_s2)
- R3 [PASS] Pass pen to R4. (r3_s5)
- R4 [RECEIVE] Receive phone from R3. (r4_s3)
- R3 [PASS] Pass phone to R4. (r3_s6)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Turn on the bedroom light. (r4_s1)
- R4 [LOCAL] Arrange items on the desk neatly, ensuring the laptop is centered and any clutter is removed. (r4_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Push the chair to align it properly with the desk. (r4_s3)
- R4 [LOCAL] Ensure the desk area is clear and presentable for the video call. (r4_s4)
